description: This file provides an API wrapper module for frontend interactions with a backend server, including functions for HTTP methods (GET, POST, DELETE, PATCH), managing authentication headers, handling errors (notably auto-logout on 401), and specific endpoints for work items and comments (fetching, adding, updating). It also includes utilities for building URLs and handling request-specific details.

methods.name: isPublicPath(path)
methods.description: Determines if a given API path is public (no Authorization header needed), e.g., login/signup endpoints.

methods.name: buildHeaders(path, extra = {})
methods.description: Builds request headers, adding Authorization if the path is protected.

methods.name: handleErrorResponse(resp, data, path)
methods.description: Handles error responses from fetch, notably auto-logout and redirect on 401 status for protected endpoints.

methods.name: apiDelete(path)
methods.description: Performs an authorized DELETE request to the backend, parsing and returning JSON data or handling errors.

methods.name: apiPost(path, body)
methods.description: Performs an authorized POST request with JSON payload, parsing and returning JSON, with error handling.

methods.name: apiGet(path, params)
methods.description: Performs an authorized GET request with optional query parameters, returning parsed JSON.

methods.name: apiPatch(path, body)
methods.description: Performs an authorized PATCH request with JSON payload, returning parsed JSON.

methods.name: getWorkItemComments({ project_id, id })
methods.description: Fetches comments for a specific work item identified by project_id and id.

methods.name: addWorkItemComment({ project_id, id, body, author_id = null, author_display_name = null })
methods.description: Adds a comment to a work item, sourcing author_id from localStorage if not provided.

methods.name: getWorkItems({ projectId } = {})
methods.description: Retrieves list of work items, optionally filtered by projectId.

methods.name: createWorkItem({ project_id, item_type, title, description, status, priority, created_at })
methods.description: Creates a new work item, setting createdBy from localStorage's displayName.

methods.name: updateWorkItemStatus({ project_id, id, status })
methods.description: Updates the status of a specific work item.

methods.name: buildUrl(path)
methods.description: Builds a complete URL by combining the base API URL with a path.
